# Real FFmpeg H.264 VAAPI admission boundary

**AI disclosure:** This file, including its title and all prose, was generated by AI.

Implementation child of [driver #37](https://github.com/iconidentify/libva-v4l2_request/issues/37)
for [omarchy-m1-video#79](https://github.com/iconidentify/omarchy-m1-video/issues/79).
It replaces the rejected PR74 remap with an **explicit stop**. Baseline/Extended
are **not** added to `vaapi_profile_map`. `vaapi_decode_make_config` still runs
from `avctx->profile` before later PPS/slice NALs are visible; that is the
named submission-boundary blocker for remap. Parent #37 stays open. AVC remains
73/135. No installed FFmpeg.

Preserve [experiments/h264-client-selection/](../h264-client-selection/) as the
blocked-design reproduction. Do not enable that archived patch.

## Reproduce

```
# #73 blocked-design reproductions (required first step)
python3 experiments/h264-client-selection/tests.py
python3 experiments/h264-client-selection/actual-gate-test.py
python3 experiments/h264-client-selection/build-reproduction.py /tmp/h264-rejected-build

# this leaf
python3 experiments/h264-client-admission/tests.py
python3 experiments/h264-client-admission/end-gate-test.py
python3 experiments/h264-client-admission/build.py /tmp/h264-admission-build
```

`build.py` links a real n9.0.1 `ffmpeg` with H.264 VAAPI **off** (no admit
symbols) and **on** (patched, four `ff_h264_vaapi_admit_*` symbols, includes
`internal.h`). `end-gate-test.py` compiles the actual `admit_end` from this
directory: an empty session does not issue; deleting the `in_picture` check
fails that assertion.

## Boundary

`decode_nal_units` cancels DPA/DPB/DPC and slice-header/hwaccel failures
before `ff_vaapi_decode_issue`, including without `AV_EF_EXPLODE`. `end_frame`
calls `ff_h264_vaapi_admit_end`, which refuses sticky or never-started
pictures and then `ff_vaapi_decode_cancel`. Remap stays disabled until a
follow-up can bind VA config to a fully parsed SPS+PPS+slice set.
